$comment: Configuration for the vendored HyperFrames engine. This is the ONE place to adjust the render invocation for your installed HyperFrames version. Do not hand-edit generated compositions — regenerate them from graphics/plan.json instead. Verify flags with `npx hyperframes render --help`.

render.$comment_extra: {fps} and {width}/{height} are substituted at call time. --transparent yields an alpha overlay (ProRes 4444 .mov) so beats composite over the footage. Drop --transparent for full-frame renders.
